one_line: Google's ad platform, manageable programmatically via the Google Ads API (gRPC/JSON-REST) down to keyword level.
auth_notes: OAuth2 (Google account) + a developer token, plus a Google Ads Manager account and API Center enablement. Requires linking a Google Ads customer ID. Developer token has test and production approval tiers.
self_serve_notes: Free self-serve developer access: create Google Cloud project, enable API, get developer token in API Center, test against a test account without approval; production access needs token approval by Google.

api_surface.breadth_estimate: Hundreds of resources/services: campaigns, ad groups, keywords, budgets, billing, reporting via GAQL, asset management, Smart Bidding, offline conversions, audience targeting
api_surface.webhook_note: No push webhooks; reporting is pull-based via GAQL queries

existing_mcp.note: No official Google Ads MCP; multiple community MCP servers exist on GitHub/npm.

evidence.note: Fetched text (3.4KB) covers API intro and positioning; auth/self-serve facts from Google Ads API docs

agent_notes: Production developer token approval is the main time sink; test accounts make sandbox calls possible quickly.
